objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for user group assignment of reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning personal authorizations and the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reviewers in the release process.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning releasers in the release process.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is calculated.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate when a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Differentiates documents for structuring and evaluation and can have templates, abbreviations, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type for checking extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration defined for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special work steps in sub-processes.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in authorizations, workflow tasks, distribution, acknowledgement, translation, or requests.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign read and change rights and distribution recipients.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document created and managed without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate documents that have no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task processed with workflow support during release, acknowledgement, validity extension, AKS, or reactivation.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users involved in workflows, change proposals, distribution, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document with assigned User Groups or persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested for distribution for acknowledgement and documented in the system.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Master data object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Master data object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Master data object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of released document content checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New documents are created in the system by Attachment of a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Corresponding document type is selected when creating new documents.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_new_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_property
evts.description: Document properties are edited to maintain metadata, authorizations, and workflow participants.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata can be maintained automatically or by the user.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with an implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Once the document has been saved, it is converted to PDF.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_document_as_pdf
evts.description: Current version is displayed on the web as a PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: assign_wf_participant
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned via property editing.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional info is added to a document by Attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is added to a document by Attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be archived if they are no longer relevant to the new version.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: Approval process is initiated after document creation, maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs in the first workflow step of Creator.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review task positively or negatively.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete the release task positively or negatively.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: Workflow is canceled for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection during review or release with multiple users.

evts.name: complete_electronic_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Document is finally released after workflow completion.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A valid and released document is revised.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version is created for changes to released documents or revision.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights create Change proposals for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: If a Change proposal is scheduled for implementation, a new document version is created.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Request for validity extension is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared, the request is deleted, and the document remains valid.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Validity extension process is automatically terminated when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Users with write access create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Workflow for processing the request for AKS is started automatically.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Document is given the status Out of force and rights are revoked except for archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Request for reactivation is created and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Workflow for reactivation starts automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the reactivation request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Equippments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists can be maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned User Groups are automatically requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: Author team receives a notification as soon as all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released content is translated into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_document_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, clients where the document is visible or not can be specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the client to make a local addition.
